## Active

### D-544 — Remove the rest-fs spike test and the dead render path

> _2026-10-13 · ext/rest-fs · active_

The ext/rest-fs memory cross-reference spike had its mechanism confirmed by hand, and only its
headless test was failing. The choice was to delete the spike test and the dead render path rather
than the whole feature, keeping the three navigable providers (hover, links, go-to-definition) that
the repository instructions advertise. The removed render path was dead because nothing in the
extension ever produced a memory: URI; every link already pointed at the real file. If the feature
itself is later judged unneeded, memoryReferences.ts and its call in extension.ts are what remain to
remove.
